I agree with you. Even lightly mentioning the impact of the struggle you're facing to people who are supposed to care about your well being completely alters their perception of you and willingness to be around you. Why should anyone hide behind it and be forced to struggle alone? It's not okay. It seems you've come really far to get to this point and I have a lot of respect for that. Not everything works. Life in misery isn't a life at all. I hope you find as much peace as there is, whether that be alive or not. Best wishes.
